intent: The editor's left navigation rail: icon destinations with a label below each, an active accent, and an optional brand button that opens a back-to-files menu.
use_when: The far-left destination switcher of an editor screen (the EditorShell navRail slot).
A small, fixed set of primary destinations, each icon + short label.
dont_use_when: A full sidebar of nested navigation — this is a compact rail.

slots.items: NavItem[] destinations (id, icon, label) — override the default Comp / Agent / Assets set.
slots.brand: Top brand button; becomes a menu trigger when onBackToFiles is provided.

a11y.destinations: each is a <button> with aria-pressed + aria-label; the visible label sits below the button.
a11y.brand: aria-haspopup=menu when it opens the back-to-files menu.
